description.zh:
文档库名称。

> 由[CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~)接口创建。您可以调用[ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~)接口查看已经创建的文档库。
description.en:
The name of the document collection.

> You can call the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation to create a document collection and call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation to query a list of document collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
实体类型列表。

> 当开启构建知识图谱时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The list of entity types.

> If the knowledge graph construction is enabled, this parameter is required.

description.zh:
LLM模型名称。

> 取值范围
> - knowledge-extract-standard：默认值。
> - knowledge-extract-mini

> 仅当开启构建知识图谱时，该参数生效。
description.en:
The name of the LLM model.

> Valid values:

*   knowledge-extract-standard: the default value.

*   knowledge-extract-mini

> This parameter takes effect only when the knowledge graph construction is enabled.

description.zh:
构建知识图谱使用的语言。取值说明：
- Simplified Chinese： 简体中文。默认值。
- English：英语。

> 仅当开启构建知识图谱时，该参数生效。
description.en:
The language used to build the knowledge graph. Valid values:

*   Simplified Chinese. The default value.
*   English.

> This parameter takes effect only when the knowledge graph construction is enabled.

description.zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账号名称。

> 您可以调用[CreateAccount](~~2361789~~)接口创建账号。
description.en:
The name of the privileged database account that has the rds_superuser permission.

> You can call the [CreateAccount](~~2361789~~) operation to create an account.
The password for the privileged database account.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过CreateNamespace接口创建，通过ListNamespaces接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

> You can call the CreateNamespace operation to create a namespace and call the ListNamespaces operation to query a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口指定。
description.en:
The password of the namespace.

> The value of this parameter is specified by [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
关系边类型列表。

> 当开启构建知识图谱时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The list of relationship edge types.

> If the knowledge graph construction is enabled, this parameter is required.

title.zh: 知识库开启构建知识图谱

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb enable-collection-graph-rag --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --namespace mynamespace --namespace-password testpassword --collection document --llm-model knowledge-extract-standard --biz-language Simplified_Chinese --entity-types 地点 --relationship-types 发生 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb EnableCollectionGraphRAG --region cn-hangzhou --EntityTypes '["地点"]' --RelationshipTypes '["发生"]' --ManagerAccountPassword testpassword --Language Simplified_Chinese --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --LLMModel 'knowledge-extract-standard' --ManagerAccount testaccount --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace
